summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a share consolidation at its Extraordinary General Meeting. The consolidation ratio is fixed at 8 old shares (par value $0.0003125 each) into 1 new share (par value $0.0025 each), effective May 19, 2026. Fractional shares will be rounded up. The board has authority to set the effective date no later than June 30, 2026. The Class A ordinary shares will trade under symbol NCI with a new CUSIP. This is a routine capital restructuring, not a special situation.
